notes.title: Version 0.9: It's 3D Now?
notes.content:
Wow, it's been a bit since the last update. I've taken this time to meticulously refine and enhance every corner of the game. From revamped graphics to exciting new gameplay mechanics, this update promises a renewed and exhilarating experience for both veterans and newcomers alike. Now that the core of the game is solid, the next updates should come (hopefully) pretty quickly. As always, please let me know if you encounter any issues or have suggestions for the game!



[h2]Major Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player now doesn't instantly drown when you go in the water. Instead, you have a bubble UI indicator which shows your remaining oxygen
[*] Overhauled visuals for pretty much everything (player, enemies, plants, the island itself, etc.)
[*] Controls are now configurable
[*] Added a clock to track wave progress
[*] Improved enemy intelligence significantly
[*] Added enemy spawners instead of enemies just randomly popping up anywhere
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed full screen switching being broken
[*] Fixed various crashes
[*] Fixed performance degrading over time
[*] Various other stuff
[/list]

[h2]Performance Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Collision system overhaul
[*] Enemy bullets now look different from player's
[*] Bombs now look more distinct from regular cannonballs
[*] Remade title screen
[*] Enemies now how tells before they attack so the player can anticipate them
[*] In-depth technical devlog coming soon!
[/list]


Mac build of this update is coming ASAP!


- Henry

notes.title: v0.8.8 and Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Henry from Two Scoop Studio here with another Cannon Father update. Version 0.8.8 is mostly a stability update to fix issues you guys reported, but also adds a few new things listed below. Please report any bugs and don't forget to rate the game!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37952088/b8074d7371a455ca04c43bb88e14cdbf47290edd.gif[/img]


Changelog

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where gamepad would not work sometimes
[*] Added more sound effects
[*] Fixed issue where sea effect would overlap ponds
[*] Added leaf and blood particles
[*] Fixed issue where enemies could spawn while game was paused
[*] Added a new original song by [url=https://www.instagram.com/stavros.xakis/]stavros.xakis[/url]
[*] Added bushes
[*] Trees and bushes now move when hit
[*] Added lighthouse
[*] Fixed issue where wave timer did not show correct end time
[*] Color scheme improvements
[*] Added two new enemy weapon types
[/list]


Roadmap
[list]
[*] New enemy types - kraken and ghost
[*] Hitbox overhaul to make it easier to hit enemies
[*] New items and status effects
[*] New cannonball type
[*] More starting islands
[*] Steam achievements
[*] Ship and ability to sail between islands
[*] Bosses
[*] Co-op?
[/list]

For the most part I'm keeping the target date for full release pretty fast and loose - there's a lot I want to add, but I also want to start adding some of the community's ideas. Also, the above list is subject to change, that's just my plan right now...

Comment any ideas for things you want added and [url=https://twitter.com/TwoScoopStudio]follow the development on Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Version 0.8.6 out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37952088/bfe39d4d620233144b479291f6b2c137b047a3bc.gif[/img]

We're excited to announce another regular update for Cannon Father. This update is mostly aesthetic improvements, but it also changes the way the island is made and fixes a few bugs. This new island is not only much better looking, but it is easier to create and is a great step towards the eventual progression-based goals for this game!

[list]
[*] Adds original music!
[*] Improves menus
[*] Color scheme is much brighter
[*] Added new tree types
[*] Palm trees are now procedurally generated
[*] Improved water edge detection
[*] Improved island shoreline and sea aesthetic
[*] Fixed crash when buying "Jolly Roger" shop item
[*] Improved shadows so they can no longer overlap
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37952088/2524bce34057fc1343b27decf613461e6bc744b3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.8.5 Released!
notes.content:
Cannon Father version 0.8.5 is here! This is a major rewrite of the code base to fix a lot of underlying issues. There are not many new features to this update per se, but there are a bunch of bug fixes, improvements, and optimizations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37952088/eb8545afa638a4de97b750fb6f75e27cbd9860a2.png[/img]

Changelog
[list]
[*]Improved look of title screen
[*]Hitbox improvements
[*]Enemies are easier to hit with projectiles
[*]Player is less prone to fall into water when standing on the shoreline
[*]Fixed issue where shopkeeper could get stuck
[*]Reduced cost of shop items
[*]Added more skeleton weapons
[*]Skeletons can now pick up any disarmed weapons
[*]Improved ammo switching HUD
[*]Added score to game over screen
[*]Buried treasure is now marked with an "X"
[*]General HUD improvements
[*]Enemies can now flee if they don't have a weapon or they feel threatened
[*]Improved appearing/disappearing sequences for buried objects/enemies
[*]Enemies now push each other out of the way
[*]More enemies spawn at the start of each wave
[*]Added more demon enemy variants
[/list]
